name: The Royal at Atlantis
insider_take: The Royal at Atlantis isn't just a hotel—it's the crown jewel of a legendary resort that houses the world's largest open-air marine habitat with over 50,000 aquatic animals.
whats_special: This iconic pink palace sits on Paradise Island and features the famous Bridge Suite (once $25,000/night), underwater tunnels through shark-filled lagoons, and the thrilling Leap of Faith waterslide that plunges through a shark tank. The resort's Dig archaeological site recreates the lost city of Atlantis with stunning detail.
pro_tip: Book the Aquaventure day pass even if you're not staying here—it's one of the world's most spectacular water parks and includes access to the marine exhibits and lazy river.
dont_miss: Swimming with dolphins at Dolphin Cay, exploring the underwater ruins in the Predator Lagoon, and catching sunset from the Cove Beach. The casino is the largest in the Caribbean, and celebrity chef restaurants like Nobu offer world-class dining with ocean views.
pros: Iconic Atlantis resort with world-class aquarium and marine exhibits
Extensive water park facilities and private beaches
Multiple dining venues and entertainment options on-site
Prime location in Nassau with easy access to Paradise Island attractions
cons: Large resort property with crowds during peak seasons
Premium pricing for dining and activities
